mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( M_NUM, ID, PW, NAME, GOODS, AGE, GENDER, K_GRADE, L_GRADE, ADMIN_M, POINT, J_DATE ) VALUES ( M_NUM.NEXTVAL, #{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{goods}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{kGrade}, #{lGrade}, #{adminM}, #{point}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT M_NUM AS mNum, ID AS id, PW AS pw, NAME AS name, GOODS AS goods, AGE AS age, GENDER AS gender, K_GRADE AS kGrade, L_GRADE AS lGrade, ADMIN_M AS adminM, POINT AS point, J_DATE AS jDate, PROFILE_SET AS profileSet FROM MEMBER WHERE ID = #{id} AND PW = #{pw}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET K_GRADE = #{kGrade}, L_GRADE = #{lGrade}, PROFILE_SET = 'Y' WHERE M_NUM = #{mNum}
mapper.select: SELECT M_NUM AS mNum, ID AS id, PW AS pw, NAME AS name, GOODS AS goods, AGE AS age, GENDER AS gender, K_GRADE AS kGrade, L_GRADE AS lGrade, ADMIN_M AS adminM, POINT AS point, J_DATE AS jDate FROM MEMBER ORDER BY M_NUM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO M_ACHIEVEMENT ( M_A_NUM, M_NUM, ACHIEVE_NUM, M_A_DATE ) VALUES ( M_ACHIEVEMENT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{mNum}, #{achieveNum}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO POINT_SHOP_HIS ( P_S_NUM, M_NUM, GOODS_NUM, GOODS, GOODS_TEXT, PRICE, PURCHASE ) SELECT (SELECT NVL(MAX(P_S_NUM), 0) + 1 FROM POINT_SHOP_HIS), #{mNum}, G.GOODS_NUM, G.GOODS, G.GOODS_TEXT, G.PRICE, 1 FROM GOODS G WHERE G.GOODS_NUM = #{goodsNum}
mapper.select:
SELECT S.POSTURE_NUM AS postureNum, S.DIVISION AS division, S.GRADE AS grade, S.G_NAME AS gName, 1 AS fileDiv, CASE WHEN S.DIVISION = 1 AND S.POSTURE_NUM = 1 THEN '/uploads/img/jungdan.jpg' WHEN S.DIVISION = 1 AND S.POSTURE_NUM = 2 THEN '/uploads/img/sangdan.jpg'
WHEN S.DIVISION = 2 AND S.POSTURE_NUM = 1 THEN '/uploads/img/vonTag.jpg' WHEN S.DIVISION = 2 AND S.POSTURE_NUM = 2 THEN '/uploads/img/pflug.jpg' WHEN S.DIVISION = 2 AND S.POSTURE_NUM = 3 THEN '/uploads/img/ox.jpg' WHEN S.DIVISION = 2 AND S.POSTURE_NUM = 4 THEN '/uploads/img/alber.jpg' ELSE '' END AS url FROM SM_GRADE S WHERE S.DIVISION = #{division} AND S.POSTURE_NUM = #{postureNum}
SELECT GOODS_NUM AS "goodsNum", GOODS AS "goods", GOODS_TEXT AS "goodsText", PRICE AS "price" FROM GOODS ORDER BY GOODS_NUM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO M_ACHIEVEMENT ( M_A_NUM, M_NUM, ACHIEVE_NUM, M_A_DATE ) SELECT (SELECT NVL(MAX(M_A_NUM), 0) + 1 FROM M_ACHIEVEMENT), #{mNum}, #{achieveNum}, SYSDATE FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM M_ACHIEVEMENT WHERE M_NUM = #{mNum} AND ACHIEVE_NUM = #{achieveNum} )

INSERT INTO TRAIN_HIS ( HIS_NUM, M_NUM, T_DATE, DIVISION, TRAIN_NUM, POSTURE_NUM, A_P ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(HIS_NUM), 0) + 1 FROM TRAIN_HIS), #{mNum}, SYSDATE, #{division}, #{trainNum}, #{postureNum}, #{accuracy} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DIVISION || '-' || TRAIN_NUM || '-' || POSTURE_NUM) AS "completeCount", NVL(ROUND(AVG(A_P)), 0) AS "avgAccuracy" FROM TRAIN_HIS WHERE M_NUM = #{mNum}

SELECT DIVISION AS "DIVISION", TRAIN_NUM AS "TRAIN_NUM", POSTURE_NUM AS "POSTURE_NUM", TO_CHAR(T_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "T_DATE", NVL(A_P, 0) AS "ACCURACY" FROM TRAIN_HIS WHERE M_NUM = #{mNum} ORDER BY T_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET K_GRADE = #{kGrade}, L_GRADE = #{lGrade}, PROFILE_SET = 'Y' WHERE M_NUM = #{mNum}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT GOODS_NUM AS "goodsNum", GOODS AS "goods", GOODS_TEXT AS "goodsText" FROM POINT_SHOP_HIS WHERE M_NUM = #{mNum} AND PURCHASE = 1 AND GOODS_NUM IN (1, 2, 3, 4) ORDER BY GOODS_NUM
